title: Witness directory
description: Shape of witnesses.json. Checks JSON Schema cannot express (alphabetical order, a key id listed at most once, each public_keys entry hashing to one of its row's key_ids) are enforced by capsule_emit.witness_directory.

binding.description: How a checkpoint reaches this witness: cll (POST /checkpoints), rekor (a Rekor dsse entry) or scrapi (SCRAPI POST /entries). Absent means cll.

public_keys.description: Base64 DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of each key that is not Ed25519. Each must hash (SHA-256) to one of the row's key_ids.

name.description: The operator's self-declared name, or the service's host name when it declares none. Rows are ordered by it.

endpoint.description: Absolute https URL of the service; no credentials, query, or fragment.

key_ids.description: 64 lowercase hex characters per key: a 32-byte Ed25519 public key, or for any other key type the SHA-256 of its DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo (listed in public_keys). More than one when the operator has rotated keys.

since.description: Date the service began issuing receipts at this endpoint, YYYY-MM-DD.
